title: Patient Sarah - Recovery Updates
content: Sarah's condition is stable with vital signs within normal limits. She is responding well to the current treatment plan and is scheduled for a follow-up scan next week. No complications have been observed, and the medical team is optimistic about her recovery trajectory. Her friend Jane has been inquiring about her condition.

title: Patient Sarah - Personal Notes
content: Sarah expressed that she has been reflecting on her life choices and relationships. She feels a strong desire to reconnect with her estranged brother and make amends. She also mentioned wanting to pursue her passion for painting, which she has neglected for years. Sarah shared these thoughts with her friend Jane, looking for comfort and understanding.
